memory.heading: What the assistant remembers
memory.body: Preferences you have confirmed. They do not fade over time, and only you can change or remove them — behaviour never rewrites them on its own.
memory.emptyBody: Preferences you save above will appear here.
memory.suggestionBodyWithCurrent: You set {field} to {current}, but you have been choosing {candidate}. Update it?
memory.notesHeading: Notes you asked me to keep
memory.notesBody: Things you highlighted that didn't fit a field above. Delete any of them and I stop using it — and when there are many, the most recent are the ones I read.
memory.notesEmpty: Nothing yet. Highlight anything in a reply and choose Remember this.

explore.helpBody: Choose a named demo destination, or click anywhere to pin multiple private inspirations. Select pins from the list to remove them individually or together.
explore.pinUpdated: Updated the {name} pin to your latest click.
explore.chatMentionedCityNote: This city was recognized from the conversation and pinned to its map center. It remains a session-only inspiration.

chat.startAria: Start a conversation with Wanderly Agent
chat.startPlaceholder: Where do you want to go?
chat.introBody: Ask for destination inspiration or general travel guidance. Live prices, availability, visa decisions and booking status are not verified here.
chat.authenticationRequired: Sign-in is required before private chat can contact the Agent.
chat.providerUnavailable: The Agent is temporarily unavailable. You can retry this same turn safely.
chat.threadMissing: That private conversation no longer exists. Retry to start a new one.
chat.networkError: The travel service could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
chat.conversationBusy: Your previous message is still being accepted. Please wait a moment, then retry.
chat.requestInvalid: This message could not be accepted. Refresh the conversation and try again.
chat.prefCardSaveFailed: Those preferences could not be saved. Please check them and try again.
chat.genericError: The message could not be sent. Please try again.
chat.planningFailed: Wanderly could not finish building the plan. Nothing about your trip was changed.
chat.planningRateLimited: Wanderly has used up its planning quota for now. Nothing about your trip was changed; try again later.
chat.planningDataUnavailable: Wanderly stopped before writing a plan: it could not get room prices for this destination, and it will not plan around a gap it cannot see. Anything it did find is kept.
chat.planningNotAllowed: Wanderly is not allowed to plan this trip right now — a permission or authorization it needs is missing.
chat.planningPreferencesChanged: Your search preferences changed while Wanderly was planning, so it stopped. Start planning again to use the new ones.
chat.planningProviderUnavailable: Wanderly could not reach a travel provider while planning. Nothing about your trip was changed.
chat.planningCompletedWithGaps: Wanderly finished a plan with these gaps: {gaps}.
chat.planningCompletedWithGaps.detail: some travel providers could not be checked — see the trip workspace for the full list
chat.planningResearchSummaryOnly: Wanderly could not write a plan this turn ({reason}), but kept what it found. See the trip workspace for details.
chat.planningResearchSummaryOnly.reasonFlight: no flight evidence was available for the recommended destination
chat.planningToolBudgetExhausted: Wanderly ran out of time calling travel providers while planning. The plan was not changed; try again to let the next turn finish.
chat.conversationEvidenceWithoutReply: Wanderly gathered {capabilityCount, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} from {providerName} (captured {capturedAtTime}) but could not finish the reply.
chat.composerNote: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line · This thread is private to you and scoped to this trip.
chat.briefProposalDatePending: to be set from trip duration
chat.startSharedPlanBody: Confirm to let Wanderly start building your complete trip plan. It will begin with 1 adult, economy, and CNY; you can adjust these later.
chat.flightConfirmTitle: Ready to search for flights — run it now?
chat.flightPreferenceBody: Choose the details below. Nothing is searched until you later confirm a flight search.
chat.flightPreferenceDatesNote: Your departure and return dates stay in the trip brief, so they can be confirmed separately in the conversation.
chat.flightPreferenceSaved: Saved. You can change any option; the newest saved choice is used.

capability.accommodation_discovery: Looking for places to stay nearby

chat.rememberedField: Remembered — it will shape what I suggest.
chat.rememberedNote: Remembered in your words. {remaining} slots left.
chat.rememberTooLong: That is {length} characters. Highlights up to {limit} can be remembered — try a shorter selection.
chat.rememberListFull: You have {limit} saved notes. Remove one to make room.
chat.rememberSensitive: Passport, date-of-birth and accessibility details are not kept as notes — add them in Travel preference, where they are never sent to the model.
chat.rememberFailed: Could not save that just now.
chat.prefCardIntro: Carried over from your travel preference. Change anything that should be different here — other trips keep what they have.
chat.prefCardReopenHint: You can reopen this any time by typing “trip preferences”.

explore.locationReference: Offline map reference: {city}, {region}, {country}. It is not an address or travel fact.
explore.locationReferenceUnavailable: Offline map reference is unavailable. Your private session pin is still saved.
explore.locationReferenceNote: This is an offline map reference, not an address, travel candidate, price, availability, visa or booking fact.
